brief:
Israeli opposition parties leading in polls may bring only marginal policy changes and no fundamental shift on Gaza or the West Bank, according to analysts quoted by Al Jazeera English. Experts suggest that a change in government would not represent a watershed moment for Palestinians facing occupation and blockade.

The assessment reflects deep structural continuities in Israeli politics across the left-right spectrum regarding Palestinian territories and their residents.
dek: Analysts say opposition win in polls may bring only marginal change and no fundamental shift on Gaza, West Bank.
title: Netanyahu's ouster unlikely to shift Israeli policy on Palestinians, analysts say
